page.notes: Page is the right printed page of the scan; the left strip shows the edge of the neighbouring page and was omitted. The foot mark "c 4" is read as the gathering signature; no separate page number is clearly printed. No running head is printed. The title "Liber Primus." is set as a level 1 division without a numeral, so no caput is given. Line-end hyphens ("RE-", "CON-", "aboli-", "in-") are joined into whole words in the heads and lines. The "pag.1" reference and the "CAP." references are kept in their lines as printed. Page numbers 25 and 28 are placed on the continuation lines they sit beside.
